tasks.title: Clear engineering parked backlog when dispatch pauses
tasks.summary: Hourly recover-queue self-heals first (cancel resolved/superseded gap-closure parks; unpark healed preflight_clash) before the cap-8 pause/email. When attention_parked_count=0 and queue_clearing.pause_active=false, board rebuild auto-acks observe-only (quiet fingerprint) — no list-parked work. When the warning still fires after recover-queue, triage remaining oldest parks via `ftse-engineering list-parked` (merge, cancel, or unpark). Queue auto-resumes when count drops below 7 and 30 minutes have elapsed since the last clearing action. Separate from project-traffic pause (stuck CI/conflict PRs).
